snippet.title: NAUTUS - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

From the studio behind Have a Nice Death comes an underwater adventure where the surface is your cozy base and the ocean floor is anything but. Pilot an upgradable submarine, fight strange creatures, and work out what happened to the N.A.U.T.U.S. research team, solo or with up to three friends. It's coming to Steam Early Access in 2027
